profile.name: Muhammad Mahedi Hasan
profile.short_bio: Building scalable web applications with modern technologies. Passionate about Laravel, Vue.js, and clean code.
about: I am a dedicated software engineer with a strong background in designing and maintaining enterprise applications. My expertise lies in backend development with Laravel and creating interactive frontends with Vue.js.
Currently working at Kaz Software, I thrive in collaborative environments where I can solve complex problems and deliver high-quality code. I love to write clean code and follow best practices.

experience.description: Contributed to global organizations (UNICEF and JICA), impacting the education and food safety sectors.
achievements: Contribute to building an offline-first data collection system allowing users in rural areas to record data without internet and sync once online.
Designed a notification archiving system that periodically stores old data using Laravel Scheduler, improving performance and storage efficiency.
Optimized applications focusing on scalability, secure APIs, and performance.

experience.description: Develop and contribute to goRMG ERP for Apparel Industries in Bangladesh and abroad.
achievements: Contributed to production tracking (ProTracker) system which increased at least 15% productivity.
Managed the deployment on various cloud platforms using pipelines, resulting in a 35% decrease in time in application deployment.
Contributed to the development of a mail system for delivering daily reports based on a user-defined schedule.
Contributed to build an automated system that generates database backups on Google Drive.
Optimized the system with Laravel queues, scheduling, and query improvements, resulting in a 30% faster application.
Implement design patterns for the reusable, maintainable, readable and refactored legacy code base.
Collaborated in the development of multiple custom Laravel packages, enhancing functionality and streamlining workflows.
Implement third-party device API for managing employee attendance.
Experienced in working with Docker for containerization and deployment.
Collaborated with and mentored junior developers, providing guidance and support.
